messages.author: e9ac8551453b903d
messages.subject: Error in addpair()
parts:
Dear Dr. Broman,

I trying to run addpair() function but getting the error message (Error in as.data.frame.default(map, stringsAsFactors = TRUE) : cannot coerce class ""A"" to a data.frame). Can you suggest the probable reason? My code is as follows

>qtl2 <- makeqtl(RiceRIL, 4, 50.83)

>out1.ap <- addpair(RiceRIL, qtl=qtl2, chr=3, verbose=FALSE, pheno.col=2)
Error in as.data.frame.default(map, stringsAsFactors = TRUE) :
  cannot coerce class ""A"" to a data.frame


Thanks,
Anurag

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Error in addpair()
parts:
This is a bug. It will be fixed in the next version. In the meantime, if you first run the following code, it will prevent the problem:

  as.data.frame.A <- as.data.frame.vector

karl
